looks.label: Metal sheen from one material record
looks.technique: NiMaterialProperty reads ambient, diffuse, specular, emissive, glossiness and alpha as one record; a metal or gilded look is numbers on a flat material, not a special shader

looks.label: Glow only where painted
looks.technique: separate gloss map (per-pixel shine) and glow map (self-light only where painted) after base, dark and detail slots

looks.label: Particle burst as one data record
looks.technique: emitter record with speed, random speed, direction cone, emit window, emit rate, lifetime spread and start-position spread; defect: the particle-count guard at line 72 tests a uint16 against 65535 and can never fire (fix: per-emitter budget with explicit error)

looks.label: Pulsing glow on a material (name only)
looks.technique: controller classes for material colour and alpha tracks, which by name would drive a pulse; controller bodies not read

looks.label: Named type registry
looks.technique: each block type registered by name with a constructor lambda; unknown names fail explicitly (README)

originals.name: Gilded Relic material
originals.idea: one flat material record per item tier, with specular and glossiness set per tier, plus a glow map painted only on engraved lines
originals.keep: flat material with specular and gloss numbers; glow only on engraved lines
originals.change: our own tier palette and maps; no donor values or art

originals.name: Ember Burst emitter record
originals.idea: one small data record for hit sparks, embers and blood motes
originals.keep: speed, random speed, direction cone, emit window, lifetime spread, emit rate
originals.change: named fields only; hard per-emitter particle cap with an explicit error; stop when off screen

originals.name: Phase pulse aura
originals.idea: elite creatures get a colour or alpha pulse on their material
originals.keep: a colour or alpha track on the material
originals.change: pulse follows the boss phase from engine state, not a fixed clock

originals.name: Effect registry by name
originals.idea: effects and looks are loaded by name from data
originals.keep: name lookup; one constructor per type
originals.change: unknown names fail at load with a clear message; no silent fallback

originals.name: Engraved rune plate
originals.idea: a gear tier marker where only the engraved lines glow
originals.keep: glow map limited to engraved lines
originals.change: our own tier colour and rune shapes
